paragraphs: Airbnb was founded in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown into a global community of over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2.5 billion guest arrivals in almost every country and region across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays, experiences, and services that enable guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. We operate a global marketplace connecting guests with stays, experiences, and services, collectively in over 220 countries and regions. Our offerings have expanded to include services and redesigned experiences, which launched in May 2025.

We operate with five key stakeholders in mind: our employees, shareholders, hosts, guests, and the communities we serve. Our commitment to making long-term decisions that benefit all these stakeholders is fundamental to our sustained success.

Our key strategic priorities include making our service better, bringing Airbnb to more parts of the world, and expanding what we offer. Over the past several years, we have introduced hundreds of new features and upgrades to our platform spanning nearly every part of our service from pricing to quality to customer support. Additionally, we are leveraging our global markets strategy, which includes a more localized approach to product updates and marketing to raise awareness and consideration in less mature markets. We are also extending our platform beyond stays with new offerings, such as Airbnb Services and redesigned experiences, with plans to continue to expand our business beyond travel accommodations using our multi-year product roadmap to help drive long-term growth.

We built our platform to seamlessly onboard new hosts, especially those who previously had not considered hosting. We partner with hosts throughout the process of setting up their listings and provide them with a robust suite of tools to successfully manage their listings, including scheduling, merchandising, integrated payments, community support, host protections, pricing tools, and feedback from reviews. In addition, we provide the Co-Host Network, which connects potential and existing hosts with co-hosts who can help manage their listings. Co-hosts are experienced hosts who provide personalized support based on the hosts' needs, from listing setup to managing bookings and communicating with guests. In 2025, we continued to deliver host improvements, including updates to cancellation policies that make it easier for hosts to earn income, better pricing tools and price tips, and a refreshed messages tab.

Our website and mobile app provide our guests with an engaging and intuitive way to discover and book a diverse selection of homes, experiences, and services. Over the last several years, we have launched a significant number of new features and upgrades to help guests find affordable, high quality and reliable stays, experiences, and services across the platform. In 2025, we launched a redesigned app experience featuring unified search and booking for all offerings, artificial intelligence ("AI")-powered personalization, and integrated social features that allow guests to connect with co-travelers or experience attendees. Guests benefit from flexible payment options, including Pay Less Upfront and Reserve Now, Pay Later. Additionally, guests can utilize enhanced search tools and improved maps to help find high-quality, reliable options that fit their preferences.

The system for trust that we designed continues to include core components such as host and guest reviews, account protection, risk scoring, secure payments, a nondiscrimination policy, watchlist and background checks in certain jurisdictions, cleanliness, fraud and scam prevention, insurance and similar protections, booking restrictions, an urgent safety line, a 24/7 neighborhood support line, anti-party technology, and a guest refund policy. In 2025, we made further investments in technology and processes to enhance trust and safety across our platform.

We offer protection for our hosts through AirCover for Hosts, which includes property damage protection of up to $3 million per stay, liability coverage of up to $1 million per occurrence for third-party claims of personal injury or property damage, deep cleaning protection, and pet damage protection.

We also offer AirCover for guests, which provides support for serious issues with a booking or during a stay, including host cancellations, inability to check-in, inaccurate listings, and a 24-hour safety support line.

During 2025, we expanded the use of AI-powered customer service and support features to help more quickly and effectively resolve issues for both hosts and guests. AI capabilities now assist in risk assessment and rapid fraud and scam detection, supplementing our existing review, watchlist, and background check procedures. We also enhanced automation in case management, supporting more timely response and resolution for urgent situations on the platform. With further initiatives under development, we are working to create additional features to strengthen the trust and safety on our platform.

Our technology platform powers our two-sided global marketplace and supports the broad, evolving needs of our network of hosts and guests. In 2025, we substantially completed a rebuild of our technology stack, enhancing scalability, reliability, and the pace of innovation across the platform. This modern architecture enables us to move rapidly in responding to changing customer needs while maintaining stability and correctness.
Given the nature of the business, our technology platform has broad and complex requirements:

•Support of secure global payments. It enables guests and hosts to transact in their preferred currency across approximately 20 local payment methods, with advanced protections against fraud and money laundering.
•Delivery of global community support. It provides multilingual, real-time community support, including responsive city-specific regulatory support.
•Delivery of deep business insights. It delivers deep business intelligence insights and robust analytics to manage marketplace performance, optimize pricing, and maximize occupancy for our hosts.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Operations
We may not be able to sustain our revenue growth rate or effectively manage growth or new opportunities.
Any decline or disruption in the travel and hospitality industries or economic downturn could materially adversely affect our business, results of operations, and financial condition.
The business and industry in which we participate are highly competitive, and we may be unable to compete successfully with our current or future competitors.
Our failure to properly manage funds held on behalf of customers could materially adversely affect our business, results of operations, and financial condition.

If one or more of our counterparty financial institutions default on their financial or performance obligations to us or fail, we may incur significant losses or be unable to process payment transactions.
The failure to successfully execute and integrate acquisitions could materially adversely affect our business, results of operations, and financial condition.
Our results of operations and financial condition could be materially adversely affected by changes in accounting principles.

Our business depends on attracting and retaining capable management and employees, and the loss of any key personnel could materially adversely affect our business, results of operations, and financial condition.
We are subject to risks associated with the physical impacts of climate change as well as various efforts to transition to a low-carbon society.
We may experience significant fluctuations in our results of operations, which make it difficult to forecast our future results.
A significant portion of our bookings and revenue are denominated in foreign currencies, and our financial results are exposed to changes in foreign exchange rates.
Changes in tax laws or tax rulings could materially adversely affect our business, results of operations and financial condition.
We may have exposure to greater than anticipated income tax liabilities.
Uncertainty in the application of taxes to our hosts, guests, or platform could increase our tax liabilities and may discourage hosts and guests from conducting business on our platform.
Our ability to use our net operating loss carryforwards and certain other tax attributes may be limited.

paragraphs: Our business, operations, and financial results are subject to various risks and uncertainties, including those described below, that could materially adversely affect our business, results of operations, financial condition, and the trading price of our Class A common stock. The following material factors, among others, could cause our actual results to differ materially from historical results and those expressed in forward-looking statements made by us or on our behalf in filings with the SEC, press releases, communications with investors, and oral statements.

Our future revenue growth depends on the growth of supply and demand for listings on our platform and the development and adoption of new offerings and initiatives. Our business is also affected by general economic and business conditions worldwide as well as trends in the global travel and hospitality industries and the short and long-term accommodation regulatory landscape. A softening of supply or demand for our current or future offerings, whether caused by events outside of our control, challenging macroeconomic and political conditions, changes in host and guest preferences, public health crises such as pandemics, and any of the other factors described in these Risk Factors and elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, or otherwise, may result in decreased revenue and our business, results of operations, and financial condition could be materially adversely affected.

If we fail to retain or add hosts and guests, if hosts do not provide high-quality stays, experiences, and services, if new offerings and initiatives on our platform are unsuccessful, or if our community support functions are inadequate, our business, results of operations, and financial condition would be materially adversely affected.

Our business success is heavily reliant on both hosts and guests engaging with our platform. Hosts must maintain and enhance their listings by offering a variety of desirable, competitively priced, and high-quality stays, experiences, and services, while providing exceptional hospitality and timely responses to guest inquiries. These factors are largely outside our direct control, and if hosts fail to meet these expectations, or if they choose to cross-list or list exclusively with competitors, or if we are unable to attract and retain hosts in a cost-effective manner, or at all, our revenue and business operations could be adversely affected.

Our ability to attract and retain guests is crucial and can be impacted by external factors such as pandemics, natural disasters, political instability, climate change, and economic downturns, as well as business-specific factors like competition, brand perception, and platform usability. Our brand and reputation are critical to our success, as they influence our ability to attract and retain hosts, guests, and employees. Any negative perceptions or incidents related to safety, security, or quality could harm our public image and business operations. Issues such as unreliable reviews, regulatory scrutiny, or negative media coverage can further damage trust within our community, materially adversely affecting our business, results of operations, and financial condition.

We continue to invest in the development of new offerings and initiatives, including innovations focused on improving the experience of our hosts and guests; however, developing and delivering these new offerings and initiatives increase our expenses and our organizational complexity, and we may experience difficulties in developing and implementing these new offerings and initiatives. New offerings and initiatives on our platform have a high degree of risk, as they may involve unproven businesses with which we have limited or no prior development or operating experience. There can be no assurance that our hosts and guests will adopt or respond positively to such offerings and initiatives, that we will be able to successfully manage the development and delivery of such offerings and initiatives, or that any of these offerings or initiatives will help attract and retain users on our platform and gain sufficient market acceptance to generate sufficient revenue to offset associated expenses or liabilities. If new offerings and initiatives on our platform are not successful, or if we fail to provide a seamless and satisfactory experience for both hosts and guests, or if our host protection programs, including those provided through AirCover for hosts, become ineffective, our business, results of operations, and financial condition could be materially adversely affected.

Except as otherwise noted, all references to 2025 refer to the year ended December 31, 2025, references to 2024 refer to the year ended December 31, 2024, and references to 2023 refer to the year ended December 31, 2023.

This section of this Annual Report on Form 10-K discusses 2025 and 2024 items and year-to-year comparisons between 2025 and 2024. Discussions of 2023 items and year-to-year comparisons between 2024 and 2023 are not included in this Form 10-K, and can be found in "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" in Item 7 of Part II of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024, filed on February 13, 2025.
Active booker An active booker is a unique guest who has booked a stay, experience, or service in a given period.
Active listing We consider a listing of a home or an experience to be an active listing if it is viewable on Airbnb and has been previously booked at least once on Airbnb (excluding HotelTonight).
Available listings Available listings are accommodations, experiences, and services that are viewable on a certain date on our platform (excluding HotelTonight).
Check-ins Check-ins represent individual stays, experiences, or services that occur during a period that have not been canceled.
Co-hosts Co-hosts are experienced hosts who provide personalized support based on the hosts' needs, from listing setup to managing bookings and communicating with guests.
Guest arrivals Guest arrivals represent an individual and all co-travelers included on a reservation for a stay for completed check-ins during a given period.
Hosts We count the number of hosts on our platform based on the number of users with available listings as of a certain date.

We make payments to customers as part of our referral programs and marketing promotions, and refund activities. The payments are generally in the form of coupon credits to be applied toward future bookings or as cash refunds.

Airbnb was founded in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown into a global community of over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2.5 billion guest arrivals in almost every country and region across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays, experiences, and services that enable guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. We operate a global marketplace connecting guests with stays, experiences, and services, collectively in over 220 countries and regions. Our offerings have expanded to include services and redesigned experiences, which launched in May 2025.

We operate with five key stakeholders in mind: our employees, shareholders, hosts, guests, and the communities we serve. Our commitment to making long-term decisions that benefit all these stakeholders is fundamental to our sustained success.

In 2025, revenue increased by 10% to $12.2 billion compared to the prior year, primarily due to an increase in the number of check-ins relating to Nights and Seats Booked and a modest increase in Average Daily Rate ("ADR").

In 2025, net income decreased by 5% to $2.5 billion, compared to the prior year, primarily due to an increase in compensation expense and marketing spend, as well as lower interest income, which was partially offset by the increase in revenue of $1.1 billion.

Airbnb 於 2007 年成立，當時兩位房東接待了三位旅客在其舊金山住宅，並已成長為一個全球社區，擁有超過 500 萬位房東，已接待超過 25 億位旅客，遍及全球幾乎每個國家與地區。每天，房東提供獨特的住宿、體驗與服務，使旅客能以更真實的方式與當地社區連結。我們運作一個全球市場平台，連結旅客與住宿、體驗與服務， collectively 在超過 220 個國家與地區。我們的服務已擴展至包含服務與重新設計的體驗，於 2025 年 5 月推出。
我們運作時以五位關鍵利害關係人為考量：員工、股東、房東、旅客與我們服務的社區。我們對做出長遠決策以造福所有這些利害關係人的承諾，是我們持續成功的基本要素。

我們的關鍵戰略優先事項包括改善服務、將 Airbnb 推廣至更多地區，以及擴展我們提供的服務。在過去幾年，我們已推出數百項新功能與升級，涵蓋我們服務的幾乎每個部分，從價格設定到品質到客戶支援。此外，我們正在運用我們的全球市場策略，包括更本地化的產品更新與行銷方式，以提高在較不成熟市場的知名度與考慮度。我們也正在將平台拓展至住宿以外，推出新的服務，例如 Airbnb 服務與重新設計的體驗，並計畫持續透過我們的多年產品路線圖，擴展業務至旅遊住宿以外的領域，以推動長遠成長。

我們建構平台以順暢地納入新房東，特別是那些先前未曾考慮成為房東的人。我們與房東合作，協助他們設置房源，並提供一套強大的工具，以成功管理其房源，包括排程、商品化、整合付款、社區支援、房東保護、價格工具與評論反饋。此外，我們提供 Co-Host 網路，連結潛在與現有房東與可協助管理其房源的 Co-Host。Co-Host 是經驗豐富的房東，根據房東的需要提供個性化支援，從設置房源到管理預訂與與旅客溝通。在 2025 年，我們持續提供房東改進，包括簡化取消政策的更新，使房東更容易賺取收入、更好的價格工具與價格建議，以及重新設計的訊息選單。

我們的網站與行動應用程式為旅客提供一個有趣且直覺的方式，以發現並預訂多樣化的住宅、體驗與服務。在過去幾年，我們已推出許多新功能與升級，以協助旅客在平台上找到經濟實惠、高品質且可靠的住宿、體驗與服務。在 2025 年，我們推出了重新設計的行動應用程式體驗，包含統一的搜尋與預訂功能，人工智慧（"AI"）驅動的個人化功能，以及整合的社交功能，使旅客能與同行旅客或體驗參與者連結。旅客可受益於靈活的付款選項，包括 Pay Less Upfront 與 Reserve Now, Pay Later。此外，旅客可利用增強的搜尋工具與改進的地圖，以找到符合其偏好的高品質、可靠選項。
我們設計的信任系統持續包含核心零組件，例如房東與旅客評論、帳戶保護、風險評分、安全付款、非歧視政策、特定司法管轄區的觀察名單與背景檢查、清潔度、詐欺與詐騙預防、保險與類似保護措施、預訂限制、緊急安全線、24/7 社區支援線、反聚會科技與旅客退款政策。在 2025 年，我們進一步投資於科技與流程，以提升平台的信任與安全。
我們透過 AirCover for Hosts 提供房東保護，包含每筆預訂最高 300 萬美元的財產損壞保護、每筆事件最高 100 萬美元的第三方個人傷害或財產損壞責任保險、深度清潔保護與寵物損壞保護。
我們也提供 AirCover for Guests，為旅客在預訂或入住期間遇到嚴重問題時提供支援，包括房東取消預訂、無法入住、房源資訊不準確，以及 24 小時安全支援線。
於 2025 年，我們擴展了 AI 服務的應用，用以協助更快且更有效地解決 hosts 與 guests 的問題。AI 能力現在協助風險評估與快速詐欺與詐騙偵測，補充我們現有的評審、黑名單與背景檢查程序。我們也加強了案件管理的自動化，支持平台上的緊急情況更為及時的回應與解決。隨著進一步的計畫正在進行中，我們正在開發額外的功能以強化平台的信任與安全。
我們的科技平台驅動我們的雙邊全球市場，並支援 hosts 與 guests 網路廣泛且不斷演進的需求。於 2025 年，我們大幅完成了科技架構的重建，提升平台的可擴展性、可靠性與創新速度。這現代化的架構使我們能迅速回應客戶需求的變化，同時維持穩定與正確性。
根據業務的性質，我們的科技平台有廣泛且複雜的需求：
•支援安全的全球支付。它讓 guests 與 hosts 能在其偏好的貨幣中透過約 20 種當地支付方式進行交易，並有先進的防詐欺與洗錢保護措施。
•提供全球社區支援。它提供多語言、即時的社區支援，包括針對特定城市的法規支援。
•提供深入的業務洞察。它提供深入的業務智能洞察與強大的分析功能，用以管理市場表現、優化價格與最大化 hosts 的入住率。

Active booker 一個 active booker 是指在特定期間內已預訂住宿、體驗或服務的獨特旅客。
Active listing 我們認為一個房源或體驗的 listing 為 active listing，如果該 listing 可在 Airbnb 上查看，且至少曾於 Airbnb 上預訂過一次（不包含 HotelTonight）。
Available listings Available listings 是指在特定日期可在我們平台查看的住宿、體驗及服務（不包含 HotelTonight）。
Check-ins Check-ins 代表在特定期間內發生且未取消的個別住宿、體驗或服務。
Co-hosts Co-hosts 是經驗豐富的房東，他們根據房東的需求提供個人化支援，從 listing 設置到管理預訂以及與旅客溝通。
Guest arrivals Guest arrivals 代表在特定期間內已完成入住的個別旅客及其所有同行旅客。
我們根據特定日期時有可提供房源之用戶數量，計算平台上的主機數量。
我們會針對客戶進行付款，作為我們推薦計畫及行銷促銷活動的一部分，並處理退款事宜。付款形式通常為可抵扣未來預訂的優惠券信用額，或為現金退款。

Airbnb 於 2007 年成立，當時兩位主機歡迎三位旅客至他們位於舊金山的住宅，並已成長為一個擁有超過 500 萬位主機的全球社羣，這些主機已迎接超過 25 億位旅客到訪全球幾乎每個國家與地區。每天，主機提供獨特的住宿、體驗與服務，使旅客能以更真實的方式與當地社區建立連結。我們運作一個全球性市場平台，連結旅客與住宿、體驗與服務，總計涵蓋超過 220 個國家與地區。我們的產品已擴展至包含服務與重新設計的體驗，這些服務於 2025 年 5 月正式上線。
我們在運作時以五位關鍵利害關係人為考量：員工、股東、主機、旅客以及我們服務的社區。我們對做出長期決策以造福所有這些利害關係人的承諾，是我們持續成功的基本要素。
2025 年，營業收入較前一年成長 10%，達 122 億美元，主要係因與住宿與座位預訂相關的入住次數增加，以及平均每日房價（"ADR"）小幅成長所致。
2025 年，淨收入較前一年減少 5%，達 25 億美元，主要係因薪資費用與行銷支出增加，以及利息收入減少，但因營業收入增加 11 億美元而部分抵銷。

headings: 與本公司業務及運作相關之風險
本公司可能無法維持營收成長率或有效管理成長或新機會。
若旅遊與餐飲產業出現衰退或中斷，或總體經濟陷入衰退，將可能對本公司業務、營運結果及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
本公司所參與之產業及業務高度競爭，本公司可能無法與現有或未來之競爭對手成功競爭。
本公司若未能妥善管理代為保管之客戶資金，將可能對本公司業務、營運結果及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
若我們的交易對手金融機構中之一或數家未能履行其對我們的財務或績效義務或無法履行，我們可能面臨重大損失或無法處理付款交易。
未能成功執行並整合併購交易，可能對我們的業務、營運結果及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
我們的營運結果及財務狀況可能因會計準則的變更而受到重大不利影響。
我們的業務依賴於吸引並留住具備能力的管理階層與員工，若失去任何關鍵人員，可能對我們的業務、營運結果及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
我們面臨與氣候變遷實體影響以及各種轉型至低碳社會努力相關的風險。
我們可能經歷營運結果的重大波動，使預測未來營運結果變得困難。
本公司大部分訂單及營業收入以外幣計價，財務結果會受到外匯匯率變動的影響。
稅法或稅務判斷的變更可能對本公司業務、營運成果及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
本公司可能面臨高於預期的所得稅負擔。
對本公司主機、旅客或平台的稅務適用性存在不確定性，可能增加本公司稅務負擔，並可能降低主機與旅客在本平台進行業務的意願。
本公司使用所得稅資產及某些其他稅務屬性的能力可能受到限制。
遵守法規與法規、訴訟及爭議
paragraphs: 本公司之業務、營運及財務表現皆面臨多種風險與不確定性，包括以下所列風險，這些風險可能對本公司之業務、營運結果、財務狀況及本公司A類普通股之交易價格造成重大不利影響。以下重要因素，以及其他因素，可能導致本公司實際結果與歷史結果及本公司或代表本公司在向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）提交之申報文件、新聞稿、與投資者溝通內容及口頭陳述中所表達之預測結果有重大差異。

本公司未來之營收成長取決於本公司平台之 listing 供應與需求成長，以及新產品與計畫之開發與採用。本公司之業務亦受全球總體經濟與商業條件、全球旅遊與旅館業趨勢，以及短、長期住宿相關法規環境之影響。若本公司現有或未來產品之供應或需求減緩，無論是因本公司無法控制之事件、挑戰性總體經濟與政治條件、host 與 guest 之偏好改變、公共衛生危機（如疫情）或其他在本風險因素及本年度10-K申報表其他部分所描述之因素，或任何其他因素，均可能導致營收減少，並對本公司之業務、營運結果與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
若本公司未能留住或增加 host 與 guest，若 host 未能提供高品質之住宿、體驗與服務，若本公司平台之新產品與計畫未能成功，或若本公司社區支持功能不足，將對本公司之業務、營運結果與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。

本公司之業務成功高度依賴 host 與 guest 皆參與本公司平台。host 必須透過提供多樣化、具競爭力價格與高品質之住宿、體驗與服務，並提供優質之招待與及時回應 guest 之查詢，來維持與提升其 listing。這些因素大多在本公司直接控制範圍之外，若 host 未能達成這些預期，或若 host 選擇跨平台或專注於競爭對手平台，或若本公司無法以具成本效益之方式吸引與留住 host，或根本無法做到，則本公司之營收與營運將受到不利影響。

本公司吸引與留住 guest 之能力至關重要，且可能受到外部因素如疫情、自然災害、政治動盪、氣候變遷與經濟衰退，以及與業務相關因素如競爭、品牌形象與平台易用性之影響。本公司之品牌與聲譽對本公司之成功至關重要，因為它們影響本公司吸引與留住 host、guest 與員工之能力。任何與安全、安全或品質相關之負面觀感或事件，可能損害本公司之公共形象與營運。如不實評論、監管審查或負面媒體報導等問題，可能進一步損害本公司社區之信任，對本公司之業務、營運結果與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。

本公司持續投資於新產品與計畫之開發，包括專注於改善 host 與 guest 之體驗之創新；然而，開發與交付這些新產品與計畫將增加本公司之費用與組織複雜度，本公司可能在開發與實施這些新產品與計畫時遇到困難。本公司平台之新產品與計畫具有高度風險，因為它們可能涉及尚未驗證之業務，而本公司對這些業務之開發或營運經驗有限或為零。無法保證本公司之 host 與 guest 會採用或對這些產品與計畫做出正面反應，亦無法保證本公司能成功管理這些產品與計畫之開發與交付，或這些產品與計畫能吸引與留住用戶，並獲得足夠市場接受度以產生足夠之營收，以抵銷相關費用或負債。若本公司平台之新產品與計畫未能成功，或若本公司未能為 host 與 guest 提供順暢且滿意之體驗，或若本公司之 host 保護計畫（包括透過 AirCover 提供之 host 保護計畫）變得無效，將對本公司之業務、營運結果與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
